scenes.headline: A trend is just two rules.
scenes.say: Forget indicators. A trend is just two simple rules.

scenes.headline: Higher highs. Higher lows.
scenes.say: In an uptrend, each high is above the last one, and each pullback stops above the previous low.

scenes.headline: Lower high, then a break.
scenes.say: When price makes a lower high and then closes below the last higher low, the structure is broken. That's often the first warning that the trend is changing.
